title: Elev8 Lattice Barrel Perc
description:
The Elev8 Lattice Barrel Perc is simplistic, stunning and effective. This one is a lot like the lattice pancake perc from elev8 except the vapour enters into the lattice barrel perc from above and is dispersed through the lattice around the side of the lattice barrel perc.
﻿Please Note: The Lattice Barrel Perc no longer comes with a 14mm whip adapter.
The elev8 Lattice Barrel Perc utilizes a 14mm female glass joint.
Included
1 x Elev8 Lattice Barrel Perc
